name: PumperRouteGaugeSheet
tagline: The pumper's daily gauge sheet – route stops, well and tank gauges, run tickets, chemical checks and exceptions in one Power Apps control.
description: A complete pumper route app for oil & gas production teams. Pumpers gauge wells, tanks and chemical injection points in route order on a phone (with an offline queue), the app flags well-down, downtime-reason, production-drop, casing-pressure, overfill, unexplained tank drops and chemical-rate exceptions, and foremen acknowledge and approve the sheet. Works in demo mode at once and binds to any collection, Dataverse table, SharePoint list, Excel or SQL table with column pickers.
features: Ordered route stops grouped by battery with Next stop / Save & next stop
Type-specific gauge form with validation and on-device drafts
Offline queue with sync on reconnect
Exception rules: well down, missing downtime reason, production drop, high casing pressure, overfill, unexplained tank drop, run-ticket checks, chemical rate tolerance, missed stops
Acknowledge-before-approve workflow, bulk approve, reopen, undo
Tank levels, days to overfill and haul requests
Start next day and unscheduled stops
Search, filters, sort, group, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and OnSave/OnCreate/OnStatusChange/OnAction events
Phone, tablet and desktop layouts; keyboard and screen-reader support
